description_en: Retrieves the details of one or more categories in a specified workspace
description_zh: 获取指定业务空间下一个或多个类目的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun bailian list-category --workspace-id llm-3shx2gu255oqxxxx --category-type UNSTRUCTURED --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCategory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of category to query. Valid value:

`UNSTRUCTURED`: A category for unstructured data.

<props="china">

This API does not support querying structured data tables.

</props>

<props="intl">

This API does not support querying structured data tables.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的类目类型。取值范围：
UNSTRUCTURED：类目。

<props="china">

暂不支持通过API查询表格（数据表）。


</props>
<props="intl">

暂不支持通过API查询结构化数据表。



</props>
parameters.name: category_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent category
parameters.help_zh: 要查询类目的父类目 ID
parameters.name: parent_category_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. To retrieve the next page of results, pass the `NextToken` value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of categories to return per page. The valid range is 1 to 200.

Default value: 20. If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than 1, the default value is used. If a value greater than 200 is specified, the maximum value of 200 is used
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页类目数量。最大值为 200。取值范围[1-200]

默认值：
当不设置值或设置的值小于 1 时，默认值为20。当设置的值大于 200 时，默认值为 200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Filters the results to include only the category with this exact name. If this parameter is omitted, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 即根据类目名称对接口返回的类目列表进行精确匹配/过滤。默认值为空，即不启用类目名称过滤
parameters.name: category_name

CategoryType.description_en:
The category type. The only valid value is:

`UNSTRUCTURED`: A standard category
CategoryType.description_zh:
类目类型，可能值为：
UNSTRUCTURED：类目

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the category is the default. Valid values:

`true`: The category is the default.

`false`: The category is not the default.

You cannot delete the default category
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认类目。可能值为：
true：是。
false：否。

默认类目不允许删除

HasNext.description_en:
Indicates whether more results are available for retrieval. Valid values:

`true`: More results are available.

`false`: This is the last page of results
HasNext.description_zh:
符合查询条件的类目数据是否存在下一页，可能值为：

true：是。
false：否

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results to return per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时每页类目数量

NextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. This parameter is omitted when no more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of matching categories
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回结果的总类目数量

Message.example: workspace id is null or invalid.

Status.description_en: The status code for the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request succeeded. Valid values:

`true`: The request succeeded.

`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功。
false：失败
